text: The first DAO in any segment to deploy reputation-weighted voting, formal tripartite separation, or AI alignment infrastructure at production scale will hold a defensible institutional differentiator, because the visibility paradox keeps competitors from pursuing the investments simultaneously.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Institutional Deficit in Decentralized Autonomous Organizations - An Empirical Analysis (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6819121
